summary.headline: Token decoding gained an unverified fast path.

walkthrough.text: decode accepts a verify flag that defaults to skipping verification.
A module-level API key constant was added.

verdict_reasoning.deciding_factor: Token verification is opt-in rather than opt-out.
verdict_reasoning.failure_mechanism: Callers that omit the flag accept forged tokens.

file_assessments.overview: Renamed module gains a verify keyword defaulting to False.
Seen only as context in this chunk.

findings.title: Verification defaults to off
findings.description: The new verify keyword defaults to False, so existing callers stop verifying.
findings.cause: The default was chosen for backwards compatibility.
findings.fix: Default verify to True and update the callers that cannot verify.

findings.title: Credential committed to the repository
findings.description: Reported again from the second chunk with different wording.
findings.cause: The value was inlined instead of read from the environment.
findings.fix: Read the value from the environment.
findings.failure_scenario: Anyone who installs the package can read the credential.
